findings.all_37_first_failures: rear calf contacts during pure yaw

hypothesis: Test whether a stronger direct non-wheel contact penalty (-6 versus -3) reduces remaining calf contacts without losing per-scenario tracking. Both height forms are disabled. Earlier -1 to -3 reduced failures; height L2 and lower-L1 did not yield a candidate.
limitations: First-failure records show contact identity, not causal pre-contact dynamics.
Prior passive traces apply to repeated controls and previous L2 policies, not unrecorded lower-L1 trajectories.
No measured optimal weight or monotonic response; -6 is a registered twofold probe, not a proven improvement.
Repeated disclosed development seeds/cases are not release acceptance.
selection: Reference passes both profiles; prefer controls if both pass both; otherwise contact6 must pass all4 seed/profile gates and have fewer failures. No extension or intermediate selection.
